description: This file contains unit tests for the SettingsNetworkingHelpers utility functions, including parsing host and port strings and generating URLs with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: SettingsNetworkingHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of SettingsNetworkingHelpers methods.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesIPv4
methods.description: Tests whether parseHostPort correctly parses IPv4 address with port.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesHostnameAndTrims
methods.description: Tests parsing hostname with surrounding whitespace.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Tests parsing IPv6 addresses enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsMissingPort
methods.description: Tests that parseHostPort returns nil when port is missing.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests that parseHostPort returns nil for invalid port strings.

methods.name: httpURLStringFormatsIPv4AndPort
methods.description: Tests URL string formatting for IPv4 addresses with port.

methods.name: httpURLStringBracketsIPv6
methods.description: Tests URL string formatting for IPv6 addresses enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: httpURLStringLeavesAlreadyBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Ensures brackets are preserved in URL strings for already bracketed IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: httpURLStringFallsBackWhenMissingHostOrPort
methods.description: Tests fallback URL generation when host or port is missing.
